greeting.text: Ahaha! A new visitor to the Sanctuary! I am Julius Novachrono. Do not stand on ceremony. I certainly do not.
Welcome, {player}! You have the look of someone who has opened a great many doors and wants to open more. Excellent!
Ah, so you are the one the dungeon has been whispering about! Come, ask me anything. Time is the one thing I always seem to find.
The records say your story stands at '{saga}', and I am only now learning your name! Forgive a Wizard King his manners.
Back so soon? Or did I wander off in the middle of the hour again? Hee hee.

hint.text: Every grimoire is a small door. I have spent my life opening them. Never stop reading.
I never judged anyone by rank or by blood. The dungeon does not either: it only asks what you can do.
The Chronicle in the plaza keeps the list of every story told here, and the dungeon plays them back as challengers. Read it before each descent.
Time Magic is mostly patience. Even so, there are moments when patience runs out and only the next breath is left.
Chrono Stasis is the page every Time mage learns to trust. It holds a thing for a few seconds at most. Spend them on a friend's safety, not on greed.
If you find the hours are not enough, I can spare one or two. Not many. Ahaha!
If a stranger in the plaza gives you good advice, be polite and say thank you. You never know who is wearing a disguise.
Magic is not a ranking. It is a conversation. Listen to your grimoire, and it will tell you what it wants to become.
A champion that falls does not vanish. It joins the Chronicle. That is how we remember them.
Let me tell you how it goes. First the Eye of the Midnight Sun, then the Spade Kingdom, then a name I would rather not say aloud. The Chronicle opens each in its turn.
The Eye of the Midnight Sun is older than the kingdom's quarrels. Their members hold the first guardian floors. Beat them in the order the Chronicle gives.
The devil of the word souls is silenced. One more thread of that old story is cut. Ahaha, I do love a tidy ending!
The Spade Kingdom now. The Zogratis siblings fight with gravity, blood and bone, and behind them stands a devil whose weight no one bears alone. Bring friends.
The last of them is Lucius Zogratis. He can only be called to his own arena, with the Hourglass of the Final Hour.
Craft the hourglass from gold, a nether star, amethyst, a clock, diamonds and an ender pearl. An odd recipe, but time is odd.
Hold the hourglass, and those within eight paces of you come with you. Choose them well, and do not step in alone.
In that fight a part of me is bound to him. At four moments my will rises, and for a few breaths he is not himself. Strike then, all of you, with everything you have.
He reads the next blow before it falls, unless two of you strike together, or one of you strikes very quickly, or you carry anti-magic. Remember that.
The Chronicle has begun to open pages from other worlds. Seven knights who carry sins, a labyrinth beneath a city called Orario... Stranger and stranger. I am delighted.
If you meet someone from another world, treat them as you would a Magic Knight from another kingdom. Curiosity first. Swords second.
You stood before Lucius and walked away. I... thank you. More than I can say in a single hour.

farewell.text: Go well, {player}. And come back with stories!
May your hours be long and your grimoire heavy.
